svg.title: The ratio is defined away from minus two and converges for x greater than minus one half
svg.desc: The graph of r equals x minus one divided by x plus two is drawn in two separate branches, with a vertical pole at x equal to minus two and horizontal asymptote r equal to one. For a nonzero first term, the convergence strip lies strictly between r equal to minus one and r equal to one. The defined graph reaches the lower boundary at x equal to minus one half. The number line has an open convergence boundary at minus one half and shades all larger x; the pole at minus two remains marked as undefined.
